#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Factorio server — generated by provision().
# Settings: <ROOT>/installs/factorio/gamedash-servers/test/server-settings.json     Map: <ROOT>/installs/factorio/gamedash-servers/test/saves/world.zip
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
# keep the join password in step with the ones set in GameDash
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/gamedash-servers/test/server-settings.json" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import json, sys
p = sys.argv[1]
d = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8"))
d["game_password"] = sys.argv[2]
json.dump(d, open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8"), indent=2)
SYNC
cd "<ROOT>/installs/factorio" || exit 1
# first start: create the map
[ -f "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/gamedash-servers/test/saves/world.zip" ] || ./bin/x64/factorio -c "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/gamedash-servers/test/config.ini" --create "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/gamedash-servers/test/saves/world.zip" || exit 1
exec ./bin/x64/factorio -c "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/gamedash-servers/test/config.ini" --start-server "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/gamedash-servers/test/saves/world.zip" \
    --server-settings "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/gamedash-servers/test/server-settings.json" \
    --server-adminlist "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/gamedash-servers/test/server-adminlist.json" --port 34197 \
    --rcon-bind 127.0.0.1:27070 --rcon-password "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" \
    --console-log "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/gamedash-servers/test/console.log"
